evidence_source: Metrics and completion outputs supplied by the repository owner from Colab; original Drive artifacts have not been independently inspected
selection_rule: Minimum validation loss across checkpoints and the two learning rates, before test generation

generated_response_evaluation.rating_process: AI-assisted owner rating with model identities hidden; not independent human evaluation

limitations: One seed and a small validation set; no statistical significance claim for the difference between variants.
Reward accuracy is not a generated-response win rate.
Response evaluation is incomplete and cannot establish improved response quality.
Preparation resolves upstream revisions; retain original prepared data and tokenizer for closest reproduction.
Original manifests, adapters, full metrics, comparison mapping and ratings require archival verification.
